Comment: Olist data quality validation using Athena

Parameters.QueryString: WITH metrics AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS unique_orders, COUNT_IF(order_id IS NULL) AS null_ids, COUNT_IF(is_delayed IS NOT NULL AND is_delayed NOT IN (0, 1)) AS invalid_labels FROM olist_analytics_db.orders_analytics) SELECT CASE WHEN total_orders > 0 AND total_orders = unique_orders AND null_ids = 0 AND invalid_labels = 0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS quality_status FROM metrics

QualityFailed.Cause: The analytics dataset did not pass validation.
